newsitem.title: CANADA: Talisman aiming for Wascana board approval.
newsitem.headline: Talisman aiming for Wascana board approval.

text.p: Talisman Energy Inc, which has launched a C$1.7 billion takeover bid for Wascana Energy Inc, is lobbying Wascana's board of directors to deem his firm's hostile advance a friendly one, Talisman chief executive Jim Buckee said on Friday.

Buckee said he urged Wascana's chairman to allow the target company's board to meet with Talisman officials -- with the aim of coming to an agreement on recommending the deal to shareholders -- before Wascana was required to respond to the bid on March 13.
The offer is set to expire on March 24.
